t2i_prompt: Clean isometric line drawing, black lines on a pure white background, uniform stroke weight, no shading, no fill, no text, no people. On the left a detailed industrial skid on a frame base with vessels, pipes, valves and a pump; on the right a smaller mobile cart carrying test instruments for <CONTENT>. Two flexible hoses arc from the skid to the cart, linking them as one test setup. Precise vector-like outlines, wide white margins, horizontal composition suitable for tracing into a single-colour mask.
signature_idea: The skid hooked up by two hoses to a test cart with gauges and a laptop: acceptance testing as one connected rig.
strengths: clearly shows testing on real equipment, meaningful for FAT/SAT
the hose link is a simple, readable story
skid looks like a genuine water system
weaknesses: very dense piping on the skid gets noisy at small sizes
stainless-looking frame and fittings, not polypropylene
brand_fit_why: Precise line art that recolours to navy on limestone and tells a real engineering story; density and stainless look pull it slightly off the calm PP brand.
